quoted_text: We prove that a matched iterative LMMSE detector can achieve (i) the optimal capacity of symmetric MIMO-NOMA with any number of users, (ii) the optimal sum capacity of asymmetric MIMO-NOMA with any number of users, (iii) all the maximal extreme points in the capacity region of asymmetric MIMO-NOMA with any number of users, (iv) all points in the capacity region of two-user and three-user asymmetric MIMO-NOMA systems.
